title: feat(data-objectstack,plugin-designer)!: no Studio or plugin-designer path sends a select / radio without its options; the object write guard holds it (objectui#11253)
body:
Fixes #11253
Clause-②: yes

The objectui half of the maintainer's ruling A on objectstack#20827 (`5910124148`): no Studio or plugin-designer path sends a `select` / `radio` without its options. Its execution parameter (2) orders objectui to change first, and the `FieldSchema` door follows once objectstack's `.objectui-sha` carries this. Card Acceptance item 4 (the door itself) is objectstack's and is not in this PR.

Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ` (dispatched `os-dev`, claim `5920025935`).

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`: the existing door guard gains the choice rule** (`object-metadata-write-guard.ts`, per triage `5917874517`). `assertObjectMetadataWritable` refuses an object body carrying a `select` / `radio` with neither a non-empty `options` list nor a `picklist` string, before any request. The message names the field, says which state it saw (no `options` key, or an empty list), and asks for an option, a shared `picklist`, or a non-choice type. `MetadataClient.save`, `importObjectDraft` and `MetadataService` all reach it, so every writer behind them is covered at one seam. No second guard module and no writer list: `pnpm check:metadata-write-doors` passes unchanged (17 doors derived, 3 can carry an object, 3 reach the guard).
- **The guard's docblock** now states the two invariants separately. The relationship refusal still only moves a server 422 earlier. The choice refusal is deliberately ahead of the server: it holds a body the installed spec still stores, by the ruling's own order. It is not a dead-bolt, because the message names the field and each surface that holds one clears it on screen (below). The claim "the installed server still accepts it" is measured by a pin, not left in prose. When the door ships and the pin moves, that pin turns red and says how to rewrite the paragraph.
- **New export `CHOICE_TYPES_REQUIRING_OPTIONS`**, derived by pin from the installed `@objectstack/spec`: every `FieldType` that `checkFieldCompleteness` reports as `field/choice-without-options` at `error` severity. `FieldSchema` cannot answer this yet, because the door has not shipped.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-designer`: the Field Designer drawer stops offering choice types.** It has no options editor, and `MetadataFieldsPage` saves every change at once. The type picker now leaves out the guard's choice types, except the edited field's own stored type, so an existing picklist still shows and round-trips with its options. The list's type filter keeps every type.
- `packages/data-objectstack/README.md`'s guard section documents both rules and the new export.
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx` are **unchanged**: measured, both already show why a held autosave is held (next section).

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **Studio sends an empty select: confirmed, red first on the wire.** At BASE `7d074baaec`, the new pin (a real `MetadataClient` whose `save` is the door, transport stubbed at `fetch`) captured a PUT carrying `{ name: 'field_2', type: 'select', label: 'New field' }` with no `options` (radio alike). The metadata-admin canvas seeds `options: []`. The guard-off ablation below shows that editor PUTs it too.
2. **The predicate.** The door is not published: objectstack `origin/main` `31c39964fc` has no `FieldSchema` refusal for "neither", and the installed 17.5.0 `FieldSchema` accepts `{ type: 'select' }` and `options: []` (and refuses `picklist` as an unrecognized key). I took the rule the ruling names as the one the door adopts, ADR-0078's `field/choice-without-options`, verbatim from objectstack `main`'s `functional-completeness.ts`: an option source is `hasEntries(options) || typeof picklist === 'string'`. The installed 17.5.0 `checkFieldCompleteness` confirms an empty list is no source (pinned). A field carrying `picklist` is never refused (pinned, with and without an empty list).
3. **The guard's contract.** The "cannot dead-bolt" sentence is rewritten per rule and cites the ruling, as above.
4. **No dead-bolt on screen: already true, so no surface change.** A guard throw inside `useDraftAutoSave`'s save lands in the Data pillar's existing error banner, which shows the guard's message naming the field. The next edit re-arms the autosave, and one option sends it. The extra case, an object that **already stores** an empty select re-saved for an unrelated label edit, is held too: the banner names the stored field, and one option typed in that field's own inspector sends a single PUT carrying both edits. In metadata-admin, the throw lands in `doSave`'s plain error branch (the banner, naming the field). `refusalBlocking` is not armed, because it holds server 422s and the guard issues no request. Each later autosave re-runs the guard locally and re-shows the banner, and one option sends the next save. Both paths are pinned on the real surfaces.
5. **plugin-designer.** The drawer offered `select` (`radio` is not in its vocabulary): now hidden. The other plugin-designer path that offers a choice type is `DataModelDesigner`, whose field-type list includes `select` / `multiselect`. It persists nothing itself (it hands entities to its host through `onEntitiesChange`, and no in-repo host saves them), so the door guard covers any host that would. A stored `radio` with no options is one of the types `MetadataFieldsPage` carries through unedited: its save is now refused by name, and that page already sends the author to metadata-admin for those types. The target-less `master_detail` precedent is refused the same way.

## Version level

Both changesets are `minor` with a BREAKING paragraph (this repository never declares `major`, per AGENTS.md's version policy). `assertObjectMetadataWritable` is a published export whose accept set narrows: a body it passes today is refused after this. It is also the one narrowing that refuses what the installed server still accepts. plugin-designer stops offering a published field type. `app-shell` changes only test files, which its `files[]` (`dist`, `src/styles.css`, docs) does not ship, so it needs no changeset of its own.

## Tests

HEAD is `54c202695f`. The broad runs were at `404d78c595`, which differs from HEAD only in `FieldDesigner.tsx` (the predicate made module-private) and its pin. Everything those two files reach re-ran at HEAD: `packages/plugin-designer/` tests, its type-check, the drawer ablation, and the six repo checks marked below.

- New pins: `DataPillar.choiceWithoutOptions-11253` (3: select, radio, stored empty select), `ResourceEditPage.choiceWithoutOptions-11253` (2: select, radio from the palette), `FieldDesigner.choiceTypesHidden-11253` (4), guard choice-rule cases (15), the derivation file's choice set plus the "installed server still accepts" reading (6), and the door pin (2).
- Fixture triage (two existing plugin-designer suites stored a choice field with no options as incidental data): `MetadataFieldsPage.saveEnvelope` and `MetadataFieldsPage.storedTypePreserved` (P1 census `radio`, P3 `f_select`, both P6 cases). None pins the choice rule, so each gains one option, as the census pin already gives `master_detail` a `reference`.
- Suites: `packages/data-objectstack/` plus `packages/plugin-designer/` plus the guard-reaching scripts, types and console suites (110 files, 1354 tests); `studio-design/` (83 files, 478 tests); `metadata-admin/` in four chunks (118, 93, 79 and 78 files: 1639 plus 1 skipped, 1200, 549, 952 tests); 32 more `app-shell` suites that reach `MetadataClient` / `MetadataService` (276 tests). All green at `404d78c595`, and `packages/plugin-designer/` green again at HEAD (30 files, 211 tests).
- Type-check: `pnpm --filter` for `data-objectstack`, `plugin-designer` and `app-shell` `type-check`, exit 0 at `404d78c595`, and `plugin-designer` again at HEAD. Their programs include every new test file (counted with `--listFilesOnly`). The build was turbo's `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure (28 tasks).
- Ablations on a committed tree, run through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each restore is proven: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The guard file is byte-identical at HEAD, and the drawer ablation re-ran at HEAD.
  - the guard's choice rule forced off: 16 red across the four choice suites (every refusal, both real-surface pins and the stored case), controls green;
  - the drawer filter forced to pass all: the two absence pins red, the two must-not-change pins green;
  - the choice array cut to `select` alone: the derivation pin red.
  - The first attempt at the first ablation was refused by the tool before any test ran (its replacement still contained the anchor). It was re-anchored and re-run as above.
- Repo checks, exit 0 at `404d78c595`, and again at HEAD for the six marked (HEAD): `check:metadata-write-doors` (HEAD), `check:new-line-citations` (HEAD) (0 new), `check-changeset-presence` (HEAD), `changeset:check` (HEAD), `check:control-bytes` (HEAD), `check:doc-fences`, `docs:check-links`, `markdown-test-inputs --audit`, `check:readme-exports` (after building the 7 README packages outside the closure; a first run could not judge them unbuilt), `check:phantom-deps` (HEAD), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:self-import`.
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint` over the 11 changed TS/TSX files (read from ESLint's own output, 11 results) gave 0 errors. The only warnings on lines this PR adds were removed. The two remaining in `FieldDesigner.tsx` are the pre-existing `react-refresh` pair on `FIELD_TYPE_CATEGORIES` / `CATEGORY_ORDER`, both also at BASE. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- The "installed server still accepts it" pin will turn red in the objectui PR that moves the `@objectstack/spec` pin onto the door. That is its job: its failure text says to rewrite the guard's choice paragraph into the relationship form and flip the pin to a refusal at `options`. Carrier: that spec-bump PR.
- The ruling names `select` / `radio` only. `multiselect` / `tags` without options stay free-form, and ADR-0078 grades `checkboxes` a warning, so the guard leaves all three alone (pinned as a counter-case).
- `object-fields-io.ts#newField` still seeds `options: []`. Under the contract that is the same as no options, so the guard holds it until the author adds one, and the seed needs no change.
- The guard message is English-only, like the relationship rule it sits beside.
- objectui#11272 and the autosave target binding from objectui#11265 are untouched.
